title: Stellantis signs deal to sell Brampton, Ont., assembly plant to Canadian armoured vehicle maker
summary: Stellantis and Canadian armoured vehicle maker Roshel Inc. have announced an agreement under which Roshel will buy the automaker's Brampton assembly plant and equipment for an undisclosed amount.

image.caption: The Stellantis vehicle assembly plant is shown in Brampton, Ont., on Wednesday, Oct. 15, 2025. (Nathan Denette/The Canadian Press)

blocks.text: Stellantis and Canadian armoured vehicle maker Roshel Inc. have announced an agreement under which Roshel will buy the automaker's Brampton assembly plant and equipment for an undisclosed amount.
Canadian armoured ⁠vehicle maker Roshel Inc. will buy the Stellantis assembly plant in Brampton, Ont., the two companies announced Monday.
In a news release, Stellantis said the announcement will "create a path to return Brampton Assembly Plant to productive industrial use."

The news comes after Unifor, which represents Canadian workers at Stellantis, said it met with Stellantis on Friday to ask about reports that the plant had been sold and said the company would not confirm or deny whether a sale had been finalized.

items: Stellantis signs MOU with Canadian armoured vehicle maker on potential sale of Brampton, Ont., plant
